definitions.explanation: The legal status of holding citizenship in a country other than the one being discussed, typically Japan.

examples.japanese: {外国籍|がいこくせき}の{住民|じゅうみん}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of residents with foreign nationality is increasing.

examples.japanese: {外国籍|がいこくせき}の{方|かた}でも{口座|こうざ}を{開|ひら}けます。
examples.english: Even people with foreign nationality can open an account.

examples.japanese: この{市|し}では{外国籍|がいこくせき}の{子供|こども}にも{日本語|にほんご}{教育|きょういく}の{支援|しえん}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: This city provides Japanese language education support to children with foreign nationality as well.

notes:
A compound of {外国|がいこく} (foreign country) and {籍|せき} (register, nationality). This is the standard administrative and media term for describing people who hold citizenship of another country. It is used in government documents, news reports, and official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外国籍|がいこくせき}の{住民|じゅうみん}: residents of foreign nationality
- {外国籍|がいこくせき}の{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}: workers of foreign nationality
- {外国籍|がいこくせき}を{持|も}つ: to hold foreign nationality
- {外国籍|がいこくせき}の{子供|こども}: children with foreign nationality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外国人|がいこくじん}: foreigner — refers to the person, while {外国籍|がいこくせき} refers to the legal status
- {国籍|こくせき}: nationality; citizenship — the general term without specifying foreign
- {二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}: dual nationality — holding citizenship in two countries
